This indicates a possible interaction between Voriconazole and ifosfamide, with ifosfamide acting as a mediator in the metabolic pathway. The lowest common ancestor of Voriconazole and ifosfamide is classified as an organonitrogen compound, suggesting a shared biochemical class that may contribute to their interaction. The integrated explanation highlights a mechanistic link through the binding of ifosfamide to Cyp2b6, potentially altering its activity. The evidence supports a role for Voriconazole in modulating Cyp2b6 function, though the exact nature of this interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
